decisions.R1325: Keep the declared caller-continuation boundary. Native unwind bypasses normal guest return. The production restore service checks worker lifetime before touching abandoned state.
decisions.R1326/R1327: Public DWORD export must return zero and Ex must return FALSE on denied admission. The original instead returns the preloaded argument size or unconditional TRUE. Preserve original output store order.
decisions.R1328: Use a distinct symbol for the original body. A translation-unit-wide substitution would also redirect internal callers away from the admission facade.
decisions.R1330/R1331: Capture the caller stack, callback cursor, INIT flag and CPU continuation before frame preparation mutates them. A scope restricted to guest simulation misses earlier failures.
decisions.R1335: Use a single short-circuit condition. Preserve restore order, terminal-worker bypass, input-ignore guard and native exception propagation. Eliminate one nested test and matching closing brace.
